nightly-bot: Nightly eval alert: grove-13b-q8 sampling drift spike on prompt suite 'longform-humanities' — regression 8.7% exact-match drop vs baseline. Failing tests: 12/120. Report: https://evals.internal/1998

maya: Saw the alert. Quick look at outputs — lots of repeated clauses and weird early-stops. Example generation:
```
Input: "Discuss the ethical implications of AI in healthcare."
Output (baseline): "...it can improve diagnoses, enable personalized treatment, and reduce errors."
Output (nightly): "...it can improve diagnoses, it can improve diagnoses, it can improve diagnoses. In conclusion..."
```

devon: Which PR touched attention slicing or microbatch reorder recently?

samir: PR #2873 changed attention slicing windowing (slice_stride tuning) and also introduced microbatch reordering to improve GPU utilization. I reverted an unrelated perf tweak yesterday but left the slice alignment change. I didn't expect RNG to be affected.

olivia: I reproduced locally with the nightly image + seed and see non-deterministic repeats for long prompts (>1024). Command I used:
```
redwood-eval-runner --model grove-13b-q8 --prompt-file eval/longform-humanities.jsonl --seed 12345 --max-tokens 150 --stream=false
```
Baseline with stable runtime + same seed does NOT repeat.

devon: Is RNG being reseeded per microbatch reorder? That would desync sampler state. Can someone grep for `rng->roll` or reseed calls in the reorder path?

samir: Looking at the reorder code now. There's a `rng->advance()` call inside `reorder_and_schedule()` to keep shuffling deterministic for perf tests. That was supposed to run only in deterministic scheduling but looks like it's hit for regular scheduling too. Adding debug prints to confirm.

maya: Nightly stats show the spike correlates with sequences that cross slice boundaries (boundary alignment at 1024, 2048). Might be an off-by-one in slice window offset that mixes KV cache order.

olivia: Also see higher entropy variance in top-k distribution when slicing is enabled. Diff from nightly eval: `mean_topk_var: +0.34` vs baseline.

triage-bot: Triage created: ENG-RT-2026. Priority: P2. Assigned to @samir. ETA 48h.

maya: As a short-term mitigation we can add a model-config override to disable attention slicing for grove-13b-q8 on canary. That should restore baseline generations while fix is prepared.

devon: Do it and trigger a canary eval run. Ping this thread when deploy is up :thumbsup:

samir: Pushed fix branch #2889: removed `rng->advance()` from reorder path and added unit test to assert sampler state equality after reordering. Starting canary deploy to `canary-rt-2`.

olivia: Running eval on canary now. Will post numbers in ~30m.

maya: Thanks. If canary looks good, plan a staged rollout with monitoring on longform suite.

samir: Update: initial canary looks promising, no repeat examples in sample of 500 prompts. Still running full eval.

nightly-bot: Canary eval queued: https://evals.internal/2001 (status: running)

olivia: Canary full run complete. Exact-match regression fixed (0.1% diff vs baseline). entropy variance reduced to near-baseline. Marking ENG-RT-2026 as in-progress -> fix validated.

maya: Great work. Follow-up: add an integration test for slice-boundary sequences and a small perf benchmark to ensure no regressions.

samir: Will open PR for tests and perf baseline.

devon: Thanks everyone. Keeping this thread pinned until PR merges. :eyes:
